enum.name: CUSMVL_TARGET_COMPONENT
enum.description: Dedicated component ids for CUSMVL companion apps. These values intentionally live in the MAV_COMP_ID_USER* private range.

entry.name: CUSMVL_COMPONENT_ALL
entry.description: Broadcast to all CUSMVL companion components.

entry.name: CUSMVL_COMPONENT_SAFE_SHUTDOWN
entry.description: Dedicated component id for voxl-safe-shutdown. Equivalent to MAV_COMP_ID_USER10.

entry.name: CUSMVL_COMPONENT_TEMPLATE_APP
entry.description: Reserved component id for the standalone custom MAVLink template app.

enum.name: CUSMVL_SHUTDOWN_TYPE
enum.description: Shutdown request type for companion services.

entry.name: CUSMVL_SHUTDOWN_TYPE_SAFE
entry.description: Perform a normal safe shutdown sequence.

entry.name: CUSMVL_SHUTDOWN_TYPE_RESERVED_FORCE
entry.description: Reserved for a future forced shutdown mode.

message.name: CUSMVL_SAFE_SHUTDOWN
message.description: Companion-computer safe shutdown request from QGC or another MAVLink endpoint.
message.field: Requester-generated id for correlation and deduplication.
Target system id, or 0 to broadcast.
Target companion component id, or 0 to broadcast.
Must be set to 1 to authorize shutdown.

message.name: QVIO_STATUS
message.description: QVIO health metrics streamed from VOXL to GCS.
message.field: 1 when data is stale or unavailable
ASCII error or warning text (null-terminated if shorter than 50)
